title: Janakiramana Te Namo - Neelambari - Tisra Triputa - Paidala Gurumurti Sastri
name: Janakiramana Te Namo

ragas.name: Neelambari
ragas.was: Neelambari - S R2 G2 M1 P N2 S’ - S’ N2 P M1 G2 R2 G2 S

text: Sri Rama, beloved of Janaki Devi, we praise you. You are the one who teaches dhanujas to save yagnas. You feel auspicious residing in the hearts of sages. You are hypnotized by sweet music. O Rama, son of Dhasharadha, shower your blessings on us. You are the well-wisher of the entire world. O Lord! Please bless us always with your beloved bhajans.

lyric: ramachandra dASaradhE rAghava vitaramE tava kRpaM
bhajanamanisaM dhEhi bhOsvAmin A iyyaM va iyya
text: Sri Rama, beloved of Janaki Devi (jAnakI ramaNa), we praise (namO namO) you (tE). You are the one who teaches (Sikshaka) dhanujas (dhanuja) to save yagnas. You feel auspicious (rAjitaM) residing in the hearts (mAnasabja) of sages (muni). You are hypnotized (lOlupa) by sweet (mAdhurya) music. O Rama, son of Dhasharadha (dASaradhE), shower (vitaram) your blessings (kRpaM) on us (mE). You are the well-wisher of the entire world. O Lord! Please bless (dhEhi) us always (amanisaM) with your (tAvakIna) splendid (suruchiraM) bhajans (bhajan).
“a iyyati iyya” – These phrases are used to adjust to the talam and have no defined meaning.
